purpose: Resolve native ownership heuristics/resets and preserve explicit material/identity across a shape-changing cut

native_source.scope: Actual isolated _cut_cells, geometry/contact/environment/Poisson/diffusion and DEC cut/core methods on manufactured small polygons; profile hooks recorded; no native Voronoi seeding or full simulation

component_policy.identities: Explicit unique stable cell, membrane, edge and environment IDs, with old-to-new/new-to-old maps
component_policy.removal: Remove named cells, their owned membranes, and all incident edges; retain order and orientation of survivors
component_policy.edge_roles: Contact edges bind their two owned membranes; field edges are independent graph edges and do not imply wound exposure
component_policy.exposure: Surviving contact neighbors are hurt; surviving partner membranes of removed contacts become exposed
component_policy.environment: Retain declared environment node identities; no implicit release or new node creation
component_policy.ownership: Explicit ownership axes; no inference from matching array lengths
component_policy.material: Archive removed values and declared quantities by stable owner ID; original = survivor + removed at each declared quantity axis
component_policy.material_precision: Declared quantities/densities require finite float64 values and explicit units; nonmaterial state preserves its numeric dtype
component_policy.density: Explicit measure and scale convert density to amount; optional new survivor measure rescales density while preserving amount
component_policy.state: Non-material state remains bitwise unchanged on surviving owners when no measure conversion is requested
component_policy.derived: Topology, field operators, owner bindings, compiled layouts and checkpoint identity require explicit rebuild after an actual cut
component_policy.checkpoint: Bind layout and field declaration identities, owner axes, shapes, dtypes and units; model checkpoint I/O separately persists numeric state, measures and removed ledgers
component_policy.empty: No-op and complete removal are defined, with stable empty axes and unchanged global environment fields

native_limits: Array lengths and a hardcoded special-name set infer ownership; equal axis lengths and unknown nested fields can be misclassified
List branches delete in place and then retain only data[index], or raise after partial mutation
The cut path recomputes geometry/environment/Poisson maps and reinitializes diffusion weights and current arrays
Gap-junction, profile, molecule/ER and fast-solver reinitialization hooks are conditional; they are not conservative remapping
Native cut_mesh documents an edge restructure index but returns removed edge indices; hanging field edges may remain without simplices
Empty/all/single-survivor geometry branches may fail; preserve actual failures without silently fixing native code
Extracellular volume maps can change while native extracellular concentration arrays survive unchanged
ATP/content release is commented out; no native material-release mechanism or conservation ledger is inferred
scope_limits: Pure removal/remapping and sparse owner/contact maps; no regeneration, mechanics, retessellation or creation of biological state
Conservative Cells behavior is distinct from native reset/ownership behavior
No whole-tissue parity, field-solver continuation, physical cut-energy or automatic checkpoint migration claim
Removed material remains an explicit sink ledger; no implicit ECM reservoir, heat, charge neutralization or ATP demand
